note: The budget hotels shortlist for scripts/sample-hotel-rates.mjs --set=budget. Every hotel named by 4+ independent sources in data/evidence.json byTopic['hotels-budget'] on 14 Sep 2026, less the formats this guide signposts instead of ranking (hostels, Zedwell, capsules, aparthotels, university rooms) and the brand-only '(brand)' records. Branches were confirmed against the source records in data/consensus/hotels-budget.json and the address the booking page shows. slug reuses the src/data/hotels.json slug where the sheet already has the hotel (inSheet: true), so 'is this slug rate-sampled' works for sheet rows. engine is where the price is read: Hotels.com wherever it lists the property; premierinn.com for Premier Inn and hub by Premier Inn, which do not sell through Hotels.com. match must appear in the booking page's own heading (letters and digits only, case ignored). A property that cannot be priced keeps its row with status and statusNote, and the report lists it.
rule: Budget means a typical sampled night of £150 OR LESS (Rob, 14 Sep 2026, data/topics/hotels-budget.json openVenueQuestions). A hotel whose median night is over the line drops out even if sources call it cheap.

excludeNights.spring: Hotels.com showed exactly £1,008 for all four room types on Sat 17 Apr 2027 (captured 14 and again 15 Sep 2026) - the same figure for a Snug room and a four-person Plush room is a placeholder, not a rate.

Hotels.com: 'can't accommodate 2 guests' on 11 and 17 Oct, 'no rooms available at this property' on 17 Feb, 12 Dec and 17 Apr (captures kept in budget-2026-09-14.json). The operator's own SynXis engine (bookings.limetreehotel.co.uk, titled 'Room Mate Lime Tree - Reservations'): 'check-in/check-out combination is not available' for 11 Oct, 17 Feb and 12 Dec; 'cannot accept departures' on the Sunday after 17 Oct and 17 Apr, i.e. no one-night Saturday stays. saturday.why: Wembley Stadium hosts an NFL game (Jacksonville Jaguars v Houston Texans, 14:30) on Sunday 18 October 2026, so Saturday 17 October is a fan night at Wembley hotels. 24 October is the nearest Saturday with nothing listed at Wembley Stadium or OVO Arena Wembley (both checked 15 Sep 2026). Rob chose the swap on 15 Sep 2026; the other four nights had nothing on at either venue.
